//: Scopes ESM to test code only. The root package.json deliberately has no "type": "module": setting it there makes esbuild emit __toESM(mod, 1) for the React imports, changing the shipped bundle's CommonJS interop semantics. Phase 0 must not alter the app (see the alwaysStrict note in tsconfig.json). Test files need ESM for import.meta.dirname, so they declare it here instead.
